KPlugin.Description: Dynamic virtual desktops: Meta+PgDown/PgUp switch and auto-create a desktop past the last one; Meta+Shift+PgDown/PgUp move every window of the current desktop to the next/previous one; Meta+Ctrl+PgDown/PgUp move only the focused window. Empty desktops are recycled, keeping at most one empty. Skips caelestia's special:* desktops.
KPlugin.Name: Dynamic Workspaces (dwmove)
